facebook.content_angle: Why waiting until spring to sell your East Auckland home could cost you more than you think — the case for acting before winter arrives
facebook.post_text:
Still thinking of selling 'later'? This could be the most expensive decision you make this year. 🍂

So many East Auckland homeowners put off listing because spring 'feels safer.' But by then, more properties hit the market — and competition eats into your result.

👉 Autumn buyers are serious, motivated, and actively searching right now
👉 Lower stock levels mean your home gets more attention from the right people
👉 Cooler months ahead slow the market — acting now keeps you ahead of that shift

The window to achieve a premium autumn result is closing. ⏳

✔️ Fewer listings means your home stands out more
✔️ Motivated buyers make stronger offers when choices are limited
✔️ Selling before winter lets you move on your own timeline — not the market's

If you've been thinking about it, the best time to have a conversation is now — not after the moment has passed.

Are you weighing up whether to list before winter or wait it out?
